title: The High Priestly Prayer
description: After the farewell discourses, Jesus looks up to heaven and prays the long prayer known as the High Priestly Prayer. He first prays for himself to be glorified, then for his disciples that they may be kept in the Father's name and sanctified in the truth, and finally for all who will come to believe through their message: that they all may be one, just as the Father and the Son are one, so that the world may know that the Father has sent him.
